title: Lightly Dehydrated Portuguese Shrimp Kebabs
description: A flavorful and nutritious portuguese-inspired meal prep dish featuring tender shrimp, with a blend of exotic spices and a hint of pepper.

ingredients.name: Large Shrimp (peeled and deveined)
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, thawed per package instructions

instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
Cut the red bell pepper and onion into large chunks.
Mince the garlic cloves and mix with smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Skewer a shrimp, a piece of red bell pepper, and an onion chunk onto each kebab.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Place the kebabs in a single layer on the dehydrator trays.
Dehydrate the kebabs for 2 hours, or until they reach your desired level of dryness.
Remove the kebabs from the dehydrator and brush them with lemon juice.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the kebabs, if using.
Let the kebabs cool completely before serving.
